title: Investing 15 Billion Dollars in a Major AI Data Center, Anthropic Plans to Build a New One in Texas with Comprehensive Support from Google

content_html:
Infrastructure investment in the field of artificial intelligence is experiencing a new wave of growth. According to insiders, data center developer Nexus Data Centers is currently engaged in in-depth negotiations around a $1.5 billion financing plan. This project aims to provide funding support for a large AI data center of Anthropic located in Texas, USA, with technology giant Google playing a crucial role as a guarantor and chip supplier.

According to the planning details, if Anthropic fails to fulfill its lease and electricity payment obligations in the future, Google will provide debt guarantees worth several billion dollars. This guarantee comprehensively covers multiple data center lease agreements signed by Anthropic, as well as power purchase contracts linked to on-site power plants. By providing strong credit support, Google not only deeply binds its core partners but also expects to gain about a 20% equity return from this data center and related power projects.

In addition to financial support, the hardware core of this data center will also fully align with Google's technology ecosystem. Anthropic plans to deploy large-scale tensor processing unit (TPU) chips designed by Google and Broadcom in the local area. Industry insiders point out that the procurement of these customized chips will be implemented through an independent supplier financing agreement between Anthropic and Broadcom. As the demand for computing power for large models continues to surge, collaboration and capital integration between leading cloud vendors and AI unicorns are becoming increasingly close.

content_html_zh:
人工智能领域的基础设施投资正在经历新一波增长。 据内部人士透露，数据中心开发商Nexus Data Centers目前正在围绕一项15亿美元的融资计划进行深入谈判。 该项目旨在为Anthropic位于美国德克萨斯州的大型人工智能数据中心提供资金支持，科技巨头谷歌作为担保人和芯片供应商发挥着至关重要的作用。

根据规划细节，如果Anthropic未来未能履行租赁和电费支付义务，谷歌将提供价值数十亿美元的债务担保。 该担保全面涵盖Anthropic签署的多个数据中心租赁协议，以及与现场发电厂相关的购电合同。 通过提供强有力的信用支持，谷歌不仅与核心合作伙伴深度绑定，还有望从该数据中心及相关电力项目中获得约20%的股权回报。

除了资金支持外，该数据中心的硬件核心也将与谷歌的技术生态系统全面对接。 Anthropic计划在当地部署谷歌和博通设计的大规模张量处理单元（TPU）芯片。 业内人士指出，这些定制芯片的采购将通过Anthropic与博通之间的独立供应商融资协议来实施。 随着大型模型算力需求持续激增，领先云厂商与AI独角兽之间的合作与资本融合日益紧密。
